reason: Independent review reproduced HTTPS_PROXY DNS disclosure and SSLKEYLOGFILE filename persistence at 99649c5. Root approved a credential-only namespace with an operator-selected suffix.

contract.exclusive_use: Only credential lookup consumes this namespace; native host environments exclude it.

changed_expectations.after: That legacy name is refused. AITM_CREDENTIAL_Operator_Selected_Linear_135 is accepted.

changed_expectations.before: Seven native names were refused by a shared reserved-name set.
changed_expectations.after: All names outside the credential namespace are refused, including the same seven native names.

cases.expected: Reject runtime, conventional and legacy names, lowercase/wrong/empty prefixes and invalid suffix characters before credential lookup or transport construction. Accept uppercase AITM_CREDENTIAL_ followed by one or more ASCII letters, digits or underscores, including operator-selected mixed-case suffixes.
With authored HTTPS_PROXY and SSLKEYLOGFILE credentials, real composition refuses before transport construction; a socket DNS guard intercepts any attempted network and no secret-named file appears.

Accepted names AITM_CREDENTIAL_HTTPS_PROXY and AITM_CREDENTIAL_SSLKEYLOGFILE remain opaque to the real urllib/TLS transport: the authored secret is not a DNS hostname or filename. A socket DNS guard prevents all actual network.
The existing actual relay child checks the updated selected name and omits its value for both native hosts.

prior_results: Retain v1/v2 frozen cases, original red/green logs and independent review evidence; earlier results did not cover the new namespace contract.
